things.name: the de Grey family's time at Wrest
things.who: the Greys: barons, then Earls of Kent from 1465, then the Duke of Kent, Jemima, Marchioness Grey, Amabel, Countess de Grey, and the 2nd Earl de Grey, then his Cowper and Lucas heirs, until the estate was put up for sale in 1917

things.name: the first record of the Greys at Wrest
things.who: of Reginald de Grey, 1st Baron Grey de Wilton, holding land in Flitton and Silsoe; papers made at his death list a 'capital messuage with a dovecote', thought to be the beginning of the house

things.name: Edmund Grey's creation as Earl of Kent
things.who: Edward IV's reward to Edmund Grey, who had changed to the Yorkist side at the Battle of Northampton in 1460

things.name: the sale of Wrest
things.who: put up for auction by Nan Herbert, Baroness Lucas, after her brother Auberon was killed in 1916; the buyer was John Murray, a brewing and coal businessman

people.name: Thomas, 2nd Earl de Grey
people.who: the owner who built the present house and the Orangery; nephew of Amabel, Countess de Grey, from whom he inherited Wrest
events: became the first President of the Institute of British Architects

people.name: Henry Grey, Duke of Kent
people.who: the owner who made the Great Garden; created Duke of Kent in 1710; grandfather of Jemima, Marchioness Grey

people.name: Thomas Archer
people.who: the architect of the Archer Pavilion

people.name: William III
people.who: King of England, Scotland and Ireland, jointly with Mary II from 1689 and alone from 1694 until 1702

people.name: Louis-Philippe
people.who: King of the French 1830–48, who sold Wrest its orange trees

people.name: Lancelot 'Capability' Brown
people.who: the most famous English landscape designer of the 18th century, who reshaped the boundary canals in 1758–60
events: became the King's Master Gardener at Hampton Court

people.name: Jemima, Marchioness Grey
people.who: the granddaughter and heir of Henry Grey, Duke of Kent; wife of Philip Yorke, who became 2nd Earl of Hardwicke in 1764
events: inherited Wrest when her grandfather died

people.name: Henry Cavendish
people.who: the scientist, a grandson of Henry Grey, Duke of Kent

people.name: Edmund Grey, 1st Earl of Kent
people.who: the first Grey Earl of Kent (1465) and Edward IV's Lord Treasurer

people.name: Amabel, Countess de Grey
people.who: Jemima's daughter, made Countess de Grey in 1816, who left Wrest to her nephew Thomas, 2nd Earl de Grey

people.name: Auberon Herbert, 9th Baron Lucas
people.who: the last family owner of Wrest, a Royal Flying Corps pilot shot down near Bapaume and killed in 1916
